content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
TMC ACTREC Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Engineer Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Engineer (Mechanical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy announced for the Engineer (Mechanical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the Engineer (Mechanical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Engineer (Mechanical) post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is between Rs. 50000 to Rs. 65000 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Full time B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering with First class and 5 years of experience, or a Full time Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with First class and 7 years of experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the interview location?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at Advanced Centre for Treatment Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra - 410210.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificate (if applicable).
